summary: The Geneva Graduate Institute offers master's students full or partial scholarships (CHF 20,000 at most), awarded for two years, and tuition reductions, based on academic excellence and financial need. Admission decisions do not take your finances into account. You can ask for aid only with an application in the January round: for September 2027, by Thursday 14 January 2027.
meta_description: Full or partial scholarships and tuition cuts for master's students at the Geneva Graduate Institute, on merit and need. Apply by 14 January 2027.
covers: A full or partial scholarship (CHF 20,000 at most), awarded for two years.
A tuition reduction, on its own or with a scholarship.
Stipends are paid monthly for living costs; recipients must live in Switzerland or neighbouring France.
eligibility: Master's applicants of any nationality; awards depend on academic excellence, financial need and the funds available.
Admission decisions are made without regard to finances.
Second-year aid must be requested again in April and May.
how_to_apply: Apply online for a master's by Thursday 14 January 2027, midnight Geneva time, and fill in the financial-situation fields.
Upload the documents on the Institute's financial aid checklist: proof of income, tax statements and bank statements.
Recommendation letters are due by 21 January 2027.
The later rounds (15 March and 15 April 2027) do not offer financial aid to master's applicants.
watch_out: If you do not ask for aid in the January round, you cannot ask later.
English at C1 level is required: TOEFL iBT 100, IELTS Academic 7.0, or Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency at 185.
The application fee (CHF 100 in January) cannot be waived.
The Institute's budget guide puts living costs at CHF 1,400 to 2,500 or more a month.
costs: Tuition (CHF 8,000 a year for applicants from abroad, CHF 5,000 for Swiss residents)
Living costs (CHF 1,400 to 2,500 or more a month)
Application fee (CHF 100 in the January round)
documents: Financial aid documents: proof of income, tax statements and bank statements
English results: TOEFL iBT 100, IELTS Academic 7.0 or Cambridge 185; a year of full-time university study taught only in English exempts you

faq.q: Does the Geneva Graduate Institute give scholarships to international students?
faq.a: Yes. Master's applicants of any nationality can ask for aid, awarded on academic excellence and financial need.

faq.q: When must I apply for a scholarship?
faq.a: With your application in the January round: by Thursday 14 January 2027 for September 2027. Aid cannot be requested later.
No. French is not an admission requirement; students below B1 take a free intensive French course.
